faq.q: What is an AI video generator for ecommerce?
faq.a: It makes a short product clip from a photo you upload and a scene you describe. You choose the frame and the length, then download the file.

faq.q: How do I make an AI video from a product photo?
faq.a: Upload one clear photo of the whole item, choose a format and a frame, describe one action, and download the clip. The credit cost shows before you start.

faq.q: What kinds of product videos can I make?
faq.a: Creator-style ads, explainers, showcases, presenter-led clips, and social clips. Open the matching tool under the format list when you want that kind of clip.

faq.q: Which frames and lengths are available?
faq.a: Frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds.
A 6-second clip uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. A failed job gives the credits back.
Yes. Run the same photo with a different opening, scene, or presenter, then compare the downloads in your ad account.
Use a clear, well-lit photo with the whole product visible. Upload only a photo you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Can I use the download in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and can be used commercially. Add your price and captions after download, and follow each platform's AI rules.

faq.q: Is the person in the video a real customer?
faq.a: No. Any presenter is generated for the ad, not a buyer. Do not present the clip as a customer review, and label AI content when a platform asks.

faq.q: Do I choose which AI model makes the video?
faq.a: No. You do not pick a model name. Upload a photo, choose a frame and a length, and describe the scene.

faq.q: Can I start from a product page link?
faq.a: Not on this page. Upload one product photo and describe the scene. For a product link, use the URL to video page.

faq.q: How long does a video take, and can I add captions?
faq.a: There is no fixed wait. It depends on the length and how many jobs are ahead of yours. Add captions, a price, and licensed music in your editor after download. This tool does not add them for you.
